definition.retrained: ridge probe (exp002 probes.linear_fit_predict) fitted on the patch-mean latent of rollout step k of the probe-training rows (a060, ind, a160: 900 rows, one sample per row) with the label of frame t+k; alpha/folds chosen inside those rows only; evaluated on the test rows' latent of the same step
definition.transfer: the Q1 probe fitted on encoder tokens only (002 output-space measurement) applied to the same latent
definition.encoder_retrained: same retraining on the encoder tokens of frame t+k (single-frame Q1 ceiling, cross-checked with 002 q1 cells f<k>)
definition.limitation_a: In condition (a) single_ind the predictor was trained on ind episodes only; its rollouts of the a060/a160 training rows (used here to train the probe) are rollouts of sizes it never saw. Condition (b) trained on all three probe-training sizes
definition.leak_rule: no test row is passed to the fit; alpha and folds are chosen by GroupKFold inside the training rows
